definition: AtomicCertificate uses the EXISTING Body of nonempty subsets of Bool. It jointly asserts population, Profile, EXISTING AtomicParts (every object has a minimal part), no least object, and finiteness. This is atomicity, not an advertised theorem that every object is the fusion of all of its atoms; atomic and atomistic are not silently identified.
